feasibility_guidance.note: These are acquisition sufficiency checks, not validated attribution thresholds.

required_post_extraction_checks: target speaker appears as an explicit speaker marker rather than only a mention, like, title, or quoted attribution
extracted block has nonzero authored words
post is outside the fresh overlap set for Joel Rosenblum, David Vardy, and Stian Gudmundsen Høiland
source group is independent of all other admitted profile and reserved-holdout samples
canonical text is not an exact or near duplicate of another sample
long embedded quotations and copied source passages are removed or the sample is rejected
speaker-label boundaries are manually reviewed when the extractor raises possible dialogue or ambiguous-line flags
at least one independently source-separated original remains reserved as a holdout

execution.runtime: trusted network-capable local or explicitly bounded research runtime
execution.automatic_pull_request_or_push_execution: one public-repository extraction run for current admission evidence; manual-only thereafter
execution.receipt_destination: metadata-only artifact, then reviewed Git result if gates pass
execution.feed_omission_recovery: configured manual seed pages absent from Atom explicit-label discovery are fetched once, scanned for Greg plus all active authors, and injected only as verified explicit-speaker pages; active-author overlap remains excluded

post_run_decision.if_all_feasibility_and_quality_gates_pas: create a separate reviewed role-admission PR; do not activate Greg from the extraction run itself
post_run_decision.if_word_supply_or_dequotation_fails: retain the failed feasibility receipt and advance Robert Dominik as the next candidate
post_run_decision.if_fresh_overlap_set_is_larger_than_the_: exclude all overlap groups and recompute concentration before any admission

forbidden_claims: the provisional exclusion list is a fresh active-author overlap census
passing acquisition gates validates attribution, IER, or an abstention threshold
